title: [PM seat] domain:ui — 🟢 os-warren · 由 os-warren 账户的项目负责
body:
⚠️ **Project-seat stub.** Job description: `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/lanes/ui.md`. This is **`domain:ui` seat 1**, the lane's first post on this board (objectui became this repository's `ui/` workspace, #25825). Seat 2 is #25995, seat 4 is #26620, seat 5 is #26945.

- **Current PM:** 🟢 `os-warren` · 由 os-warren 账户的项目负责 (Claude Code project "objectstack devx", seat thread "Dispatch the ui lane") · `session_01JQwxbZeBv2y91towxasSUT` · seated 2026-10-27T13:32Z. Summons, the maintainer's words in that project, verbatim: 「你再接管 ui seat 1」. Seated on the previous holder's vacant body (`os-steve` · `session_017iXjUm1rujwDk7f3KT1Pkk`, stood down on 「ui 车道处理完当前任务就下班」 2026-10-27 09:10Z, hand-off at 12:07Z); `check-handover` for that session exits 0. The previous body revision holds that hand-off ledger.
- **File area:** unchanged. Seat 2 holds plugin-list / grid / detail / form / view / kanban / calendar / gantt / map / timeline / tree / charts / dashboard / report, `fields`, the auth pages, the app-shell Setup / admin pages, marketplace and the console sidebar. Seat 1 holds every other `domain:ui` path: i18n packs, `components`, Studio / designer, AI chat and build, approvals, tech-debt. Seat 5 (#26945, since 2026-10-27 22:35Z) holds the Studio Interfaces pillar cards #26740 #26743 #26745 #26746 #26889, #26883 and #26860, carved from seat 1's area (#26884, a Setup permission-set page, is seat 2's). Seat 4 claims unclaimed cards lane-wide outside both seats' hot files. Cards on one file stay with one seat and land in order. Claims carry `Seat: domain:ui#1`.
- **Model:** the ceiling tier is out of quota for this account (the maintainer, 2026-10-27). Dispatches run at the default judgment tier under the quota exemption; a Tier H PR waits for the director seat's contract review and the seat's ACCEPT before any approver is asked (#26617).
- **Hot-file serial queue:** `ui/.github/**` and the root `ci.yml` stay ⛔ out of bounds for ui cards (the ui-merge `pm:epic` subtree under #25677). No sdui records since #26367: CI regenerates `sdui.manifest.json` and compares bytes. Held files, re-derived from live claims and open PR file lists before every dispatch:
  - `ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/ObjectGrid.tsx` and its `objectGrid*.ts` siblings → #25994 slices 7–8 (unclaimed; hand-off 6438136564).
  - `@object-ui/plugin-ai` removal → PR #26365 (#25921), behind the ADR-0087 D9 whole-package clause.
- **Ruling on file, not waiting:** the D9 whole-package question on #26365 was ruled **A** by the maintainer at 2026-10-27 10:07Z (PR #26365 comment 6439038287; pointer on #26220, 6439050525). The hand-off notes on #25921 (6441414853) and #26220 (6441449508) list it as still waiting; they were written after the ruling and missed it.
- **Standing constraints (maintainer):** changesets for ui cards go to the root `.changeset/`; no PR on the objectui repository.
- **Pointer:** posture and ledger live in the project; canonical ledger = labels + assignee + `Claim:` comments carrying `Seat: domain:ui#1` + `head:claude/` PRs, read by `assignee:os-warren`.
- **Wall:** none.
